```{r}
#| label: set-up
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(targets)
library(tarchetypes)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(lubridate)
library(broom)
library(gt)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)

# Set targets store path
tar_config_set(store = "../_targets")

```

## Data transformation

### Raw data
```{r}
#| label: fig-raw-plot
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

tar_read(raw_functions_plot)

```


### Standardize data

```{r}
#| label: fig-correlation-plot
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: Correlation between all functions (untransformed data).
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 12

tar_read(correlation_plot)

```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-responses
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: PCA of all functions.
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8

tar_load(big_data)

big_data |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(response = paste(sort(unique(response)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Ecosystem functions by group") |>
  cols_label(group = "Group", response = "Ecosystem functions / responses")

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-pca-plot
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: PCA of all functions.
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8

tar_read(all_functions_pca_plot)

```



## Single function analyses

Model output for each ecosystem function: treatment × temperature × precipitation (excluding single removals F, G, B).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-model-single-function
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| tbl-cap: "Model output from testing effect of treatment, summer temperature and annual precipitation on each ecosystem function."

tar_read(model_single_function_out)
```

Model 2 (treatment × climate + total biomass):

```{r}
#| label: tbl-model-single-function-biomass
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| tbl-cap: "Model output: treatment × climate + total biomass (Bio) on each ecosystem function."

tar_read(model_single_function_biomass_out)
```

Model 3 (biomass composition G/F/B × climate only):

```{r}
#| label: tbl-model-single-function-fg-biomass
```
